endorsements.name: David Kennedy
endorsements.label: The Dirty South â€“ Getting Justified with Technology
endorsements.description: It seems that every day there's a new NextGen firewall, whitelisting and blacklisting, DLP, or the latest technology thats suppose to stop us. But does it really stop "hackers"? Truth is, naw not really. In this talk we'll be showing off the latest bypass techniques for the "latest" hacker stoppers, using a universally whitelisted website as our middle man for a command and control, social engineering our way into some of the toughest companies, and showing off some techniques that work for us. This talk is about throwing misconceptions of protection and safety out the window, and going back the dirty south. Where thinking outside of the box is a requirement. We'll be releasing two new tools, one that makes meterpreter invisible over the network, and the other a shell that uses a popular third party as the command and control. A vulnerability scanner won't help you herrrrrrre.

endorsements.name: David Kennedy
endorsements.label: Adversaries Rising: Looking Ahead in Security
endorsements.description: We continually see capabilities of various adversaries ranging from ransomware to nation states continue to change their tactics, techniques, and procedures to go after larger and larger companies. Our defenses largely rely on crowdsourced data, but those are largely for more mature companies that have the capabilities of understanding them and building them into their defenses. Defense is still complex, attacks continue to get more complex â€“ how do we fix where lower-risk security breaches are only granted to a small percentage of companies with large security teams. This talk will dive into some previously known data breaches, current methods that attackers are using, and look into the future of how we need to tackle security.
